notes: Lived most of her later life with Adelaide Zedd at 1749 Arlington St. That is where she became seriously ill (believed to be heart failure) and spent her final days prior to passing away. According to the obituary, Emilie immigrated from Russia on July 16,1910 to New York, and it is believed then to Montreal by train. See photocopies of SS Prinz Friedrich Wilhelm July 16, 1910. On this document, her name is spelled "Emilde". Rose Schneider provided Emilie's Certificate of Naturalization on Aug.15/01.  In that document her name is shown as "Emilia" and her birthdate as December 10, 1876.
